text_en: He said to me, O mortal, eat what is offered to you; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.
text_cn: 以后他向我说：“人子，将给你的吞下去。你吞下这卷书，然后去向以色列子民宣讲。”

text_en: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.
text_cn: 我遂张开口，他便使我吞下那卷书，

text_en: He said to me, Mortal, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your stomach with it. Then I ate it; and in my mouth it was as sweet as honey.
text_cn: 并向我说：“人子，要吞到肚子里，要把我给你的这卷书充满你的五内。”我遂吃了，这卷书在我嘴里甘甜如蜜。

text_en: He said to me: Mortal, go to the house of Israel and speak my very words to them.
text_cn: 然后他向我说：“人子，起来往以色列家族那里去，向他们宣讲我所说的话。

text_en: For you are not sent to a people of obscure speech and difficult language, but to the house of Israel—
text_cn: 你被派遣，并不是往言语不通，说话不懂的人民那里去，而是到以色列家族。

text_en: not to many peoples of obscure speech and difficult language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
text_cn: 也不是到言语不通，说话不懂，而你听不明白他们话的各民族那里去；若是我派遣你到他们那里，他们必肯听你的话。

text_en: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they are not willing to listen to me; because all the house of Israel have a hard forehead and a stubborn heart.
text_cn: 但是以色列家族却不肯听你，原来他们不肯听我，因为以色列家族都额坚心硬。

text_en: See, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.
text_cn: 看，我要使你的脸坚硬，好像他们的脸，使你的额坚硬，好像他们的额。

text_en: Like the hardest stone, harder than flint, I have made your forehead; do not fear them or be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house.
text_cn: 使你的额好像金钢，比火石还坚硬。他们虽是叛逆的家族，不必害怕他们，在他们面前不必胆怯。”

text_en: He said to me: Mortal, all my words that I shall speak to you receive in your heart and hear with your ears;
text_cn: 他又向我说：“人子，我向你说的一切话，要听到耳中，存在心里。

text_en: then go to the exiles, to your people, and speak to them. Say to them, “Thus says the Lord God ”; whether they hear or refuse to hear.
text_cn: 起来，到充军者，你百姓的子民那里，向他们宣讲，对他们说：吾主上主这样说。不管他们听不听。”

text_en: Then the spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord rose from its place, I heard behind me the sound of loud rumbling;
text_cn: 当上主的光荣由那地方升起时，神力也把我举起，我听见在我后面有轰轰之声很大，

text_en: it was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another, and the sound of the wheels beside them, that sounded like a loud rumbling.
text_cn: 是活物的翅膀彼此摩擦的响声，是靠近它们的轮子的响声，轰轰之声很大。

text_en: The spirit lifted me up and bore me away; I went in bitterness in the heat of my spirit, the hand of the Lord being strong upon me.
text_cn: 神力把我举起，把我提去；我走时，心中激动而苦闷，那时上主的手重压在我身上。

text_en: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib, who lived by the river Chebar. And I sat there among them, stunned, for seven days.
text_cn: 以后我到了特耳阿彼布的充军者那里，他们靠近革巴尔河居住。我在他们那里忧郁地居留了七天。

text_en: At the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 过了七天，上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, I have made you a sentinel for the house of Israel; whenever you hear a word from my mouth, you shall give them warning from me.
text_cn: “人子，我派你作以色列家族的守卫；当你由我口中听到什么话时，你应代我警告他们。

text_en: If I say to the wicked, “You shall surely die, ” and you give them no warning, or speak to warn the wicked from their wicked way, in order to save their life, those wicked persons shall die for their iniquity; but their blood I will require at your hand.
text_cn: 几时我向恶人说：你必丧亡！你若不警告他，也不宣讲，使恶人知所警惕，而脱离邪道，为得生存；那恶人要因自己的罪恶而丧亡，但我必向你追讨血债。

text_en: But if you warn the wicked, and they do not turn from their wickedness, or from their wicked way, they shall die for their iniquity; but you will have saved your life.
text_cn: 你若警告了恶人，而他不肯离开罪恶和邪道，那他必要因自己的罪恶而丧亡；至于你却救了你的灵魂。

text_en: Again, if the righteous turn from their righteousness and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before them, they shall die; because you have not warned them, they shall die for their sin, and their righteous deeds that they have done shall not be remembered; but their blood I will require at your hand.
text_cn: 几时一个义人离弃正义而行不义，我要在他面前安放绊脚石，使他死亡；若你没有警告他，他必因自己的罪恶而丧亡，他所行的正义，也不被记念；但我必向你追讨血债。

text_en: If, however, you warn the righteous not to sin, and they do not sin, they shall surely live, because they took warning; and you will have saved your life.
text_cn: 但若你警告了义人，使他不犯罪，而他没有犯罪：这样他必要生存，因为他听从了警告，你也救了你的灵魂。”

text_en: Then the hand of the Lord was upon me there; and he said to me, Rise up, go out into the valley, and there I will speak with you.
text_cn: 我在那里时，上主的手临于我，他向我说：“起来，到平原里去，我要在那里同你说话。”

text_en: So I rose up and went out into the valley; and the glory of the Lord stood there, like the glory that I had seen by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
text_cn: 我就起身到了平原。看，上主的光荣停在那里，就如我在革巴尔河所见过的光荣；我遂伏地掩面。

text_en: The spirit entered into me, and set me on my feet; and he spoke with me and said to me: Go, shut yourself inside your house.
text_cn: 有一种神力进入我身，使我站起来。他向我说：“你去，把你关锁在房中！

text_en: As for you, mortal, cords shall be placed on you, and you shall be bound with them, so that you cannot go out among the people;
text_cn: 人子，你看，人们要用绳索捆缚你；你被捆起后，便不能到他们中间。

text_en: and I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be speechless and unable to reprove them; for they are a rebellious house.
text_cn: 我还要使你的舌头紧贴在上颚，使你成为哑巴，不能斥责他们，因为他们是叛逆的家族。

text_en: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, “Thus says the Lord God ”; let those who will hear, hear; and let those who refuse to hear, refuse; for they are a rebellious house.
text_cn: 但是我给你说话时，要开启你的口。以后你要向他们说：‘吾主上主这样说。’谁肯听，就让他听；谁不肯听，就让他不听好了，因为他们是叛逆的家族。”
